subject: Tenant lifecycle handoff — SOC2/ISO artifact timeline
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearbridge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@clearbridge.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Artifact timeline for upcoming SOC2/ISO review

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. Our SOC2/ISO readiness team has a scheduled window the week of Jan 11 for artifact collection. To keep timelines tight, can Redwood provide a staged delivery plan for the tenant lifecycle artifacts we discussed (tenant manifests, TTL/retention mappings, deletion proof samples, and archival indexes)?

Specifically we need:
- An inventory (tenant_manifest) showing creation/decommission timestamps for a sample of 50 tenants
- A mapping doc tying retention TTLs to storage tiers and region (ideally per-tenant)
- A copy of the deletion workflow and evidence (logs, snapshots) for at least two sample erasures
- Any escrow/archival export procedures and index files

Do you prefer SFTP push or a secure Drive share? Also let us know if you need a formal DocuSign attestation for evidence receipt.

Appreciate a rough delivery schedule by EOD Monday so I can coordinate internal reviewers.

Best,
Elena
Senior Compliance Manager
ClearBridge Financial
[Attachment: cb_artifact_request_v1.pdf (12 KB)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:39:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact timeline for upcoming SOC2/ISO review

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. We can do a staged delivery and prefer a secure Drive share for initial artifacts, with SFTP available for larger exports if you prefer. Proposed timeline below (all times PST):

Stage 1 (by 2026-12-16):
- tenant_manifest.jsonl (50-sample) — includes creation, last-active, decommission timestamps and tenant IDs (anonymized).
- clearbridge_soc2_artifact_list.xlsx — index of all artifacts we can produce and estimated sizes.

Stage 2 (by 2026-12-21):
- retention_mapping_v1.pdf — TTL mapping per storage tier and regional residency notes.
- Deletion workflow doc + two redaction/erasure log snapshots.

Stage 3 (by 2027-01-06):
- Archival/export index and one sample archival export (metadata-only).
- Optional: full log trace for one tenant (if you sign the attestation).

Marissa, can you attach the tenant_manifest stub and the sample erasure logs to this thread? Grace, please confirm the retention mapping is the latest (we rolled a small update in Nov).

We recommend Drive for the first two stages; once Elena confirms we'll share folder links and pre-signed S3 objects for any larger files. If ClearBridge needs DocuSign attestation, we can route that; please send the template or let us know the required fields.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tenant_manifest.jsonl (3 KB)]

Hi Elena —

Attached is the anonymized tenant_manifest.jsonl sample (small stub) and two erasure log snapshots. Notes:
- tenant IDs are hashed; we include created_at, last_active_at, decommissioned_at, region, and storage_tier.
- Erasure logs include job IDs and timestamps; we redact token-level details but preserve audit traces required for an auditor to validate the deletion flow.

For retention mapping, see the shared Drive folder (link below) where Grace has dropped the current mapping PDF and a short readme explaining TTL rules per tier. If you require per-tenant signed attestation before we release full logs, please confirm and we'll push the DocuSign flow.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@clearbridge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@clearbridge.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact timeline for upcoming SOC2/ISO review

Markus / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the Drive link. The artifact list looks good. Two quick asks before we kick off formal collection: 

1) Please include the mapping between the anonymized tenant hashes in the manifest and the sample erasure log job IDs (so auditors can correlate sample flows). We appreciate the hashing but need a verifier mapping kept under strict control (DocuSign attestation acceptable).

2) Can you provide an explicit statement of the retention policy version we are receiving (e.g., "Retention policy v2026-11-02 — applies to customers onboarded before 2026-07-01"). A signed attestation PDF attached or DocuSign link is ideal so our audit tracker can close this item.

If you send the mapping and the attestation by 2026-12-16 we’ll be set for the Jan 11 window.

Elena
Senior Compliance Manager
ClearBridge Financial
